# Underground Network

> Underground is a global strategic advisory and influence firm working at the intersection of government, business, capital and media. A small group of partners personally leads every engagement, with discretion, lawful conduct and measurable outcomes as the firm's standards.

Headquarters: 200 Massachusetts Ave NW, Washington, DC 20001, USA. Offices in Douala (Cameroon), Abidjan (Côte d'Ivoire), Lagos (Nigeria) and Paris (France).
General contact: info@un-der.com | +1-571-508-9170

## Core pages
- [About](https://un-der.com/about): who Underground is and the principles behind every mandate
- [Capabilities](https://un-der.com/capabilities): government and political affairs, international relations and diplomacy, strategic intelligence, investment and capital strategy, business development, media and narrative management, PPP and infrastructure advisory, think-tank advisory
- [Sectors](https://un-der.com/sectors): government and public sector, energy and natural resources, infrastructure and transportation, defense and security, technology and innovation, finance and investments
- [Engagement models](https://un-der.com/engagement-models): advisory retainers, project-based engagements, government affairs support, crisis management and special situations
- [Global reach](https://un-der.com/global-reach): regions and offices
- [Team](https://un-der.com/team): the firm's partners
- [Insights](https://un-der.com/insights): original analysis on geopolitics, capital flows, government affairs and infrastructure

## Working with Underground
- [Confidential inquiry](https://un-der.com/confidential-inquiry): the secure channel for new mandates, reviewed personally by a partner
- [Membership](https://un-der.com/membership): vetted tiers for sovereign partners, principals and corporate affiliates
- [Contact](https://un-der.com/contact): offices and departmental mailboxes (partnerships, proposals, projects, media, policy, business)
